sections.content:
You know *volver a* + infinitive "to do again" from A2 Unit 28 (*Volví a ver esa película*, *Nunca vuelvas a hacer eso*). This lesson adds three things.

1. It works in every tense: *volvió a llamar*, *ha vuelto a llover*, *volveré a intentarlo*.
2. With *no*, it means "not ... again": *No volvió a llamar* means she did not call again after that.
3. It says the same as the adverbs *otra vez* and *de nuevo*: *Llamó otra vez* = *Volvió a llamar*.

sections.title: volver a + infinitive
rows: Volvió a llover por la tarde.
It rained again in the afternoon.
Hemos vuelto a hablar con el director.
We have spoken to the director again.
I will not be late again.

sections.content: Do not confuse *volver a* + infinitive with *volver a* + place, which means "to go back to": *Volvió a casa* is not "he did it again". Object pronouns go before *volver* or on the end of the infinitive: *Lo volví a leer* = *Volví a leerlo*.
